expected_findings.root_cause: The OR composition checks for retry_all when deciding whether to flatten an existing retry_any.
expected_findings.failure_path: with `(A & B) | C`, the retry_all on the left is spliced into the retry_any as if it were a plain list of predicates, so the combination behaves as `A | B | C`: a retry fires when only A holds although the author required A and B together; no error is raised and the extra retries are silent
